dz: 西塞罗发表首篇针对马克·安东尼的《腓力辞》（Philippicae，即抨击性演说）。他将在随后几个月里发表14篇此类演说。
de: Cicero launches the first of his Philippicae (oratorical attacks) on Mark Antony. He will make 14 of them over the following months.
